_comment_nerf_retiers: 2026-09 nerf severity pass: tiers follow how much of a game the nerf takes away, not how clever it sounds. Nerfs that ban a capture type or a few squares sit at 2-4; ones that remove a piece's core movement or a whole class of captures sit at 5-7; ones that make winning nearly impossible (no checks, no captures, hidden board, lose conditions the opponent can force) sit at 8.

_comment_balance_pass_2026_09: 2026-09 full balance pass, structural lenses first (dominance ladders inside a family, twins priced apart, permanent unconditional upgrades under the temporary anchors, one-shot defensive cards with no rider), win-rate sweep second. Every move below has a CARD_HISTORY event in src/data/cardHistory.ts.
_comment_material_ladder_2026_09: 2026-09 material pass, the last 18 entries of `retier`: every card is priced against the MATERIAL it moves, at 0.5 tiers per pawn, anchored on the two floors this pass already pinned (an extra piece-class is Tier 4, an amazon-class upgrade is Tier 7). scripts/material-model.ts scores each card and prints who sits below their floor; the ladder itself is pinned as executable assertions in scripts/test-balance-pass-2026-09.ts so a later blanket pass cannot quietly walk a permanent bishop back down to Tier 3. Rows the parser is known to read wrong are held out by name in KNOWN_MISREAD and were NOT moved.
